entity.question_template: Which company or organisation is described as {attribute}? Answer with the organisation name only.

numeric.question_template: For {subject}, what is the reported value of {attribute}? Answer with the number and its unit only.

period.question_template: For {subject}, which reporting period does the statement about {attribute} refer to? Answer as FYYYYY or FYYYYYQn.

provenance.answer_format: Note N | Item N | Exhibit N
provenance.question_template: For {subject}, which note, item or exhibit is cited for {attribute}? Answer with the reference only.

scope.question_template: For {subject}, which business segment or geography does the statement about {attribute} apply to? Answer with the segment or geography label only.
